title: BookCircle — Online Book Marketplace
description: Built scalable RESTful APIs and services for a book marketplace using Spring Boot and FastAPI. Supported 1,000+ listings and reduced average response time by 40% through optimized queries and caching.

title: Stock Market Trend Prediction Using LSTM
description: Developed an LSTM-based deep learning model to predict stock market trends using historical data from Yahoo Finance. Achieved 92% directional accuracy with a sliding-window approach, visualized performance using Matplotlib.

title: PERN Family Management CRUD App
description: Developed a full-stack CRUD application for managing family member records using PostgreSQL, Express, React, and Node. Created modular RESTful endpoints and reusable React components.

title: Embedded UAV Flight Controller (Final Year Project)
description: Engineered an embedded UAV flight controller integrating TinyML models for real-time anomaly detection and automated safety responses. Designed custom drone hardware in Fusion 360 and optimized aerodynamics for prototype testing.
